_meta.purpose: Short notes from the people who love Sam. These appear in the Daily Lift rotation, styled differently from the general entries, roughly twice a week.
howToAdd: 1. Open this file on GitHub and click the pencil icon to edit.
2. Copy one of the entries below, paste it at the end of the list, and change the id, from, and content.
3. Make sure there is a comma after the entry before yours, and no comma after the last one.
4. Scroll down, click Commit changes. That is it. It will show up in the app.
If that sounds like too much, just send your note to Chad and he will add it.
guidance: Short is better. Two or three sentences.
Specific is better than general. A real memory beats a general sentiment every time.
You do not have to mention her health at all. Most of the best ones will not.
Do not write anything you would not say out loud on a bad day.

notes.content: I built this because I could not think of anything else useful to do, and because you should not have to spend your energy doing math about a chicken sandwich. Text me when something on here is wrong and I will fix it.
